records.utterance: *Stands up, eyes red, looking at you and the others. His lips move, but nothing comes out.*
records.response_truth: Pick it up. Answer the radio. Now.
records.response_pred: Raph, take a breath. We're all here for you. Don't bottle it up. Just...grab something useful and let's get back to work. We need you focused, not lost in there.

records.utterance: These past few days… I know I haven't been easy to be around.
records.response_truth: Nah you were fine. You kept us alive, that's what mattered.
records.response_pred: No worries, everyone's got their off days. Just keep moving forward, that's what matters.

records.utterance: *The three of them drift apart, each doing their own thing. No one takes charge. The silence settles over the camp.*
records.response_truth:
Alright, three hours. Let's not sit here doing nothing.

Pack what's worth keeping, leave the rest. Douse the fire properly, don't just kick sand on it. And someone flatten that SOS on the beach so the rescue team knows we're accounted for and not still missing.

Michelangelo get up, you can stare at the sky from the helicopter. DaVinci stop fussing over what to pack, take everything and sort it later.

Donatello, close the notebook. It's done.
records.response_pred:
Alright, enough of this. Leo, you take stock of our supplies. Raph, check our perimeter for any threats. Mikey, go gather more firewood if you can.

And if any of you have something useful to contribute, speak up now. Otherwise, just get to work. We don't have time for this.

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.
records.response_truth: Good. Hold onto that feeling, you're almost there.
records.response_pred: Dreams don't mean a thing out here. Focus on the here and now and getting us the hell out of this mess, not someplace we can't get back to. Go prep that food or something useful.

records.response_truth:
Yeah I know. And if we'd hit day five with nothing I'd probably have thanked you for it.

But we didn't. So eat it now, share it, and we call it even. No point carrying guilt onto the helicopter.
records.response_pred: Yeah, yeah, I get it. But emergencies aren't when you're just thirsty. Now, if it was an actual emergency, like a leak over our food or something, then yeah, go ahead. But not for a little thirst, got it? We're all in this together, so no hoarding. If you need it, we all need it.

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?
records.response_truth:
Honestly? Not much. Maybe been quicker to call out the solo resource thing before it became a pattern. And I would've pushed harder on the raft earlier, before the plane scare.

But the big stuff - keeping the group moving, covering all three priorities, not letting anyone fall apart completely - I think that went alright.

What would you change? And be honest, not the clean answer you'd put in a report.
records.response_pred: Hm, well first off, no way we'd still be in this mess if we hadn't split up in the beginning. Stick together, that's rule one. Other than that, probably wouldn't have wasted time on all the extra little stuff. Focus on essentials, water, food, shelter, and getting out. Everything else can wait or be ditched. So yeah, stay tight, stay focused, ditch distractions. That's what I'd do differently.

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.
records.response_truth:
Yeah do it. Might actually be useful if this ever happens again to someone.

Send me a copy when it's done. I'm curious what the numbers look like from the outside.
records.response_pred: Good idea, but don't wait. Start compiling it now. The sooner we have that data ready, the quicker we can figure out our next move. And make sure it's detailed, we need all the information we can get on our supplies and surroundings.

records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?
records.response_truth:
None. They didn't serve any practical purpose.

But they made DaVinci feel like himself out here, which kept him functional, which kept the group together. Sometimes that's worth more than practical.
records.response_pred: Flowers? DaVinci probably just wanted something pretty to look at. Out here, we don't have time for pretty pictures. We need to focus on what keeps us alive.

records.utterance: *His cheering stops. He looks over at you, notices you haven't moved, and the smile slowly fades. He waits.*
records.response_truth: Yeah I'm good. Just give me a second.
records.response_pred: Yeah, I know. It's just...sometimes you gotta do what you gotta do. Let's get back to work. There's still plenty to do.

records.utterance: Rescue is here… they're waving us over. Are you going? I'll follow you.
records.response_truth: Yeah I'm going. Come on, let's move.
records.response_pred: Yeah, let's go. Stay close, but don't lose your head. We made it, but that doesn't mean everything's smooth sailing from here. Keep an eye out and follow my lead. Let's do this.
